request: the owner, 2026-10-09 (relayed by the orchestrating session): "SUNSET ISLAND: something special. It is empty, and it needs a reason to sail there." The unit: find the island, make a place on it that is unlike every other place, give it life at the area's band, and say how a player learns of it and gets there.

premise.found: No data file names 'Sunset Island' verbatim. The island is data/regions.json `sunset_isle` ('Sunset Isle', the large south-western island, 2.559 km2, bounds x816-3551 z6664-8015, sub-regions sunset_west (savanna, tier 5, 28-38) and sunset_east (flower meadow, tier 8, 43-53)). 'Sunset West' (data/towns.json) is the harbour TOWN on the mainland shore of the strait, not part of the island (docs/world-building/SIDE_ISLANDS.md F3). The ferry dock is data/ferries.json `sunset_isle_landing`.
premise.chosen: sunset_isle. It is the only island with 'sunset' in its id; the other candidate, Sunset West, is a town on the mainland and is already built.
premise.empty: 'Empty' is true of the west half and not of the whole island: the east has the Old Orchard (data/old_orchard.json) and the Orchard Sleeper, and the western crest has the Dusk tower (Necrozma Dusk Mane, (1156, 146, 7216)). Measured 2026-10-09 over every coordinate in every data/*.json file: nothing authored lies in x980-1160 z7380-7620 (the site's neighbourhood) or in x780-1000 z7150-7750 (the whole west coast). The sub-region sunset_west is a roster with no place in it.
premise.west_is_not_a_cliff: The brief's example was 'the western cliff'. Measured on the canonical heightmap, the west coast has no cliff: from the shore at x818-1010 the ground climbs about 0.4 blocks per block (y63 at the water, y100 at +100, y137 at +250) to a plateau at y133-142 along x1070-1160 for z7260-7640. The site is the plateau's western shoulder, a 5-block-range shelf, not the shore.

site.measured: 2026-10-09 from tools/ground.py (the canonical heightmap, rounded). The terrace footprint lies on ground y134-137 (range 3); the shelf is the flattest 25 by 25 window of the island's west (range 2 at (1072, 7492)). West of the terrace the ground falls to the sea 250 blocks away and 75 blocks lower; the nearest authored data of any kind is the Dusk tower, about 280 blocks north-east.
site.findable: From the sea, a lamp on a 13-block mast at the top of the shoulder. From the isle's ferry landing (2575, 6899): west along the north shore with the sea on the right, then up the brow to the lamp. The keeper's and the ferrymen's lines and one waymark sign at the landing say so (landing_post below).

bounding_boxes.why: every column the Watch writes or clears (terrace, hut, mast, trees, foliage, approach), for the integrator's collision check with other builders' places
the waymark sign at the isle's landing, 1,500 blocks from the rest

site.bounding_boxes_rule: every write and every clear lies in sunset_watch_all or sunset_watch_landing_box (tools/sunset_watch_audit.py footprint)

blocks.rule: vanilla 1.21.1 only. No chest (a chest is a Gimmighoul condition), no bed (the blackout's checkpoints own respawn), no flower (every vanilla flower is a Combee condition, data/spawn_blocks.json), no bell (Chimecho), no sand (the herd spawns). Every id below was measured against data/spawn_blocks.json on 2026-10-09: none is a spawn condition.

terrace.extra_paving_why: the lamp house's forecourt, two rows of paving from the terrace's north edge to the door's wall, [lx0, lz0, lx1, lz1], at the terrace's level
terrace.why: a paved shelf 32 by 23 on the plateau's western shoulder, level at the HIGHEST ground under it (the foundation courses are stone brick down to each column's own ground), so the low west lip stands up to a few blocks out of the slope as a retaining wall: from the sea it reads as a built brow. lx is east of the centre, lz south of it.
terrace.paving_why: stone brick, a quarter mossy and a tenth cracked by a fixed hash of the column, so a rebuild writes the same block; the dial is let into it.

dial.why: a stone dial 17 across: a smooth-stone ring, twelve hour marks of chiselled brick at 30 degrees, polished andesite between, and a single chiselled-brick plinth at the centre one block proud of the floor. The plinth is the dusk Habitat Block's mimic. The dial is lettered by nothing: the keeper says it counts the hours of the light, not the hours of the clock.

gate.why: the Sun Gate: two 2 by 2 pillars of stone brick 8 high and a lintel across them, set on the terrace's west lip with a 7-block opening (lz -3..3) on the dial's east-west axis. Minecraft's sun sets in the -x direction (ASSUMED from the vanilla sky's axis, not measured in game): a player standing at the benches, east of the dial, looks west through the gate at the last of the light. Three lanterns hang from the lintel on chains.

parapet.why: a low stone-brick wall along the west lip, broken for the stair run (the gate's opening is wider than the way down).

stair_run.why: the way down to the slope, three wide, through the gate's opening: stone-brick stairs one lower each column, each on a stone-brick foundation to its own ground, stopping where the stair meets the ground, then a dirt path for six more columns. It is the only walk from the lip to the slope; the keeper's boats came up it.

benches.why: six benches in two groups, three rows each, of stone-brick stairs with their backs to the east and their seats open to the west and the gate, either side of a two-wide aisle (lz -2..2). Room for twelve people to wait, which is what the Watch is for.

hut.why: the keeper's lamp house, 7 by 7 outside on the terrace's north side, spruce on a stone-brick footing under a gable running east-west, the door in the south wall onto the terrace. Inside: the guild's store barrel in the north-east corner (the find), three casks on the north wall, a lectern with no book, a crafting table and a rain cauldron, a lantern from the ridge. No bed.

mast.why: the lamp mast: a spruce pole 13 high at the terrace's north-east corner, a cross-arm of spruce fence near the top with a lantern on a chain at each end, and a lantern at the crown. It is the mark the place is found by from the sea and the slope. The day Habitat Block sits in its second log.

lamp_posts.why: lit as a town (docs/STATE.md 'Places are lit as towns'): a lantern on two spruce-fence posts at the corners, the aisle's head, the hut door and along the approach. Lanterns, never light blocks.

approach.why: the way in from the east, from the savanna: a dirt path every second column on the grass, with lantern posts every ten. The landing's waymark says 'west'; this is the last stretch of it.

trees.why: five wind-bent acacias, the savanna's tree, round the terrace's margin and the hut: a 5-log trunk with a one-block step at its third log towards the east (they lean from the sea wind) and a flat two-course crown of persistent leaves. Foliage for the shoulder, which is otherwise bare.

foliage.why: wind-flattened tufts through the margin: about one column in ten outside every feature, on a grass block, single-block plants only (a two-block grass set by command loses its lower half to the first neighbour update).

landing_post.why: the waymark at the isle's ferry landing: two stripped-spruce stumps, a standing sign on one and a lantern on the other, facing north, 17 blocks straight ahead of the arrival spot (the landing faces south onto the isle, data/ferries.json sunset_isle_landing, (2575, 63, 6899)), on dry beach (ground y63; the forecourt and jetty lie at z6880-6900, the sign is 12 blocks past the last of them, off the jetty's keep_clear x2571-2573 z6880-6896 and the ferryman's spot). It is the only block this pack writes on the east of the isle.

entries: Dreepy: Cobblemon 1.8.0's own coastal dusk Pokemon (spawn_pool_world/0885_dreepy.json: ultra-rare, weight x5 at dusk, levels 2-27, #cobblemon:is_coast and is_ocean). Here it is at the band's 30-38 and the pool's anchor, but only in the dusk window
Lycanroc in its Dusk form (spawn_pool_world/0745_lycanroc.json 'lycanroc dusk', timeRange dusk): the sunset dog. A final stage from Rockruff at 25, so it spawns over 30-38

Drakloak, the nest's elder: the middle of the Dreepy line (stock levels 50-55, dusk x5), here 45-48 so that it is the next leg's cap (45) and not the one after. Above the tier-5 cap (40); a party that meets it early is out of its depth. Rare: weight 2 of 32, one spawn in sixteen
dusk.why: An ACTIVATED Habitat Block (the den's and the orchard's pattern) in the dial's centre plinth, disguised as a chiselled brick. Every entry carries timeRange dusk, which tools/compile_spawns.py compile_habitat carries into the pool and Cobblemon 1.8.0's HabitatSpawn reads (docs/research/notes/habitat-blocks-underground.md section 1). Outside the dusk window (ticks 11834-13701 of 24000, about 93 seconds of a 20-minute day, read from TimeRange in the 1.8.0 jar) the pool has nothing to offer and the block spawns nothing.

entries: Swellow: the savanna's swallow, final stage of Taillow (22), so the whole band; it roosts on the mast
Swablu: the cloud bird, evolving at 35, so it spawns 28-38 with its evolution Altaria only at 35+
day.why: A second activated block in the mast's second log, so the Watch is not dead until dusk. Its own block and pool because an activated block counts what it has alive against its cap: day birds sharing the dusk block would sit on the cap and shut the dusk pool out. Day birds only (timeRange day, ticks 23460-12541, the jar's 'day').

npc.why: Isaura Dray, the Watch's last keeper: she stands on the terrace's open pavement between the dial and the first bench row, facing west to the gate, on her column's paved floor + 1. Placed over RCON by spawnnpcat after a restart (tools/reapply.py 'npc' action, R18SW after R17N), the class shipping in cobblers_dialogue compiled from data/dialogue.json.

find.message: In the guild's store barrel, under a tarred sheet: eight Dusk Balls and a Spell Tag, the lamp-keepers' kit for what comes at sundown.
find.why: a cache (data/rewards.json, ADR-002): reaching the hut's north-east corner grants it once per player; the barrel is scenery. Eight Dusk Balls are the right tool for the thing the place is for (a Dusk Ball catches best at night and in the dark; the dusk window is the edge of it) and a Spell Tag is the Dreepy line's own type boost. No evolution stone: stones are allocated (docs/mechanics/EVOLUTION_STONES.md) and this is not a stone's place. Ungated, as every cache is. Both items verified in the 1.8.0 jar (assets/cobblemon/models/item).

access.ferry: data/ferries.json sunset_strait: Sunset West's south pier to sunset_isle_landing, $100 each way, no gate (reachable at 0 badges). Then about 1,600 blocks west along the north shore.
access.water_mount: Surf (Misty's gym training, S2; data/water_mounts.json surf) along the isle's north and west coast from the pier or the landing: about 2,170 blocks round the outline (the region polygon's vertices from the landing to the Cape, measured 2026-10-09, an estimate and not a sailed path), then 233 blocks and 72 of climb from the beach at x821 to the terrace's lip. Not shorter than the walk (1,616 straight), but it stays off the island's tier-8 east, and it is the only way to arrive at the Cape from the sea, which is the way the lamp is seen.
access.on_foot_from_the_landing: the first 500 blocks west of the landing (x2575 to x2048, along z6860-6910) are sunset_east, tier 8, 43-53 (cap 55), against the tier-5 cap of 40 that the Watch is pitched at. Cobblemon's wild Pokemon do not hunt a walker (ASSUMED, not tested here), so this is not a wall; it is a view of what the isle holds later. The straight line from the landing to the terrace is 1,616 blocks and peaks at y140.
access.intended_badge: tier 5 (data/encounter_design.json rules.tiers: band 28-38, cap 40), the leg Erika to Koga: four badges held. Reachable at 0 badges by ferry ($100, no gate); by Surf from badge 2 (Misty's training). The Drakloak at 45-48 is the 'meet it early and regret it' creature: 5-8 over the cap of the leg the place is pitched at.
